svg.title: Plugins: every computation is a row on one kernel; what a result may do is not
svg.desc: Eleven live rows sit in sockets around a kernel that offers four primitives: provide, inject, effect and event. They are grouped as signal sources, data and policies. The brief, the session reports and the intraday check-ins ask the kernel for a service by name. A row that fails stops only its own readers. Below, the research rows feed a walk-forward optimiser whose result meets a registered gate with a floor set in code; the verdict is candidate or refused, with live permission false either way, and goes to the lab ledger. No path leads from the ledger back to a live row.

text.tspan: Swap what computes. Not what a result is allowed to do.
Every signal, policy and data source is a row. The gate and the record are not.
lift over the row above zero
No path back to a live row.
Changing a row is a reviewed edit.
